about.title: Made with care. Designed to last.
about.subtitle: Luma Living was born from a passion for design that never compromises on craft.
about.title_2: A story that started in a small workshop
about.paragraph1: In 2018, Layla Al-Hassan opened her first workshop in Dubai with a simple idea: great furniture should be accessible without compromising quality or beauty.
about.paragraph2: Today, every piece we make reflects that same commitment — carefully chosen materials, passionate designers, and craftspeople who take pride in their work.
about.paragraph3: From a single sofa to over 40,000 homes, our goal remains unchanged: to make space better.

quality.title: Uncompromising Quality
quality.description: Every piece is crafted from sustainably sourced materials and rigorously tested to last a lifetime.

design.description: We design furniture that lives with you — beautiful at first glance and functional every day after.

sustainability.title: Sustainability First
sustainability.description: We source wood from certified forests and use low-VOC finishes, because the planet is part of the brief.

humanCentered.title: Human-Centred
